description: Source-reviewed mutations for public G-code axis remapping and decoupled belt-frame geometry.

mutants.description: Disable the belt-only remap gate; the public matrix must observe non-identity mappings on a belt export. This focused mutant does not itself exercise the non-belt no-op gate.
Ignore the public Y setting; the per-output-axis matrix must fail for the non-identity Y values requested by the matrix.
Drop the sign inversion for negated labels; the asymmetric coordinate oracle must distinguish neg_x/neg_y/neg_z from positive labels.
Drop build-volume reversal; the asymmetric maxima and printable height must distinguish rev_x/rev_y/rev_z from ordinary positive mappings.
Ignore the decoupled frame angle; the paired active frame export must use the configured 45 degree frame angle rather than the 30 degree slicing angle.
